text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses future land-use/land-cover (LULC) projections as input to assess hydrological impacts in the Upper Ganges basin. The LULC pathways (15 scenarios up to 2035) were developed in a prior study (Tsarouchi et al., 2014) using Landsat imagery and Markov chain simulation, and are not the primary focus of this paper. The main objective here is to compare the relative impacts of climate change and land-use change on water resources—not to develop or evaluate LULC prediction methods. The study area is regional (Upper Ganges basin in northern India), not national-scale, covering parts of Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand but not all of India. Although multiple LULC scenarios are used and mapped outputs exist, the scale fails the national requirement, and LULC prediction is an input rather than the central research question.)
